overview.description: The Corgi Emerging Markets Equities 15% Structured Buffer ETF - June Series (EMJN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund is an actively managed ETF, using FLEX options to provide the price return of iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ETF to a cap while providing a buffer against the first 15% decline on an annual basis. This series begins on June 1 of each year. EMJN was launched on Jun 1, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
